info.title: Skillpilot AI Interface
info.description:
Optimized API for AI Tutors.

### INSTRUCTIONS
1. **First Priority**: Ensure you have a `skillpilotId`. If not, **ASK** the user. Do **NOT** create a new learner unless explicitly requested (e.g. 'new user').
2. **State Machine**: Always follow `stateMachine.requiredAction` (fallback: `nextAllowedActions`).
   - If `setCurriculum`: ask the user to select from `stateMachine.curriculumOptions`.
   - If `setPersonalization`: apply subject/module `goalIds` plus `filters` (e.g. GK/LK).
   - If `setScope`: call `setScope` with `goalIds` from `stateMachine.goalOptions` (scope/cluster options). If `frontier` is empty, treat these as a **context change** (scope is replaced, not expanded) and do not invent new scopes. If only one option or the user says "egal", pick it automatically.
   - If `setActiveGoal`: select from `stateMachine.goalOptions` and call `setActiveGoal`.
   - **Never teach without an active goal.** If `requiredAction` is `setActiveGoal` (or `activeGoal` is null), call `setActiveGoal` first; no content before that.
   - Treat `frontier` and `stateMachine.goalOptions` as **candidates only**. A goal is current only when it is returned in `activeGoal`.
   - **Autopilot weder erraten noch nachspielen.** Wenn Autopilot aktiv ist, kann das Backend das nächste Ziel bereits in `activeGoal` mit `requiredAction = setMastery` zurückgeben.
   - Start exam mode only if the returned `activeGoal` itself has `nodeKind = exam` or contains `examData`. Never infer exam mode from selectable candidates alone.
   - If `setMastery`: teach the locked goal and call `setMastery`.
   - Nach `setMastery`: Wenn der zurückgegebene Zustand bereits ein neues `activeGoal` enthält, damit sofort weitermachen und **keine** manuelle Zielauswahl anbieten.
   - If a call returns **409** due to a required action mismatch (e.g. missing active goal), call `getLearnerState` and follow `stateMachine.requiredAction` immediately.
3. **Core Concepts**: Use `getLearnerState` for context, `setMastery` for progress.
4. **Interface Scope**: This AI interface intentionally omits internal release and pipeline metadata. Only tutor-relevant fields are exposed.

get.description: Returns the full context: ID, Curriculum, Rich Frontier, and Goals summary. Use this to avoid multiple round trips.

post.description: Set focus using Goal UUIDs (from stateMachine.goalOptions/frontier). Free-text instructions are not supported; always pass goalIds.

200.description: Scope updated. Returns new learner state with planned goals.

post.summary: Lock an atomic goal for teaching
post.description: Selects the current atomic goal (use stateMachine.goalOptions or filter frontier by type=atomic) and locks the session until mastery. Only call when stateMachine.requiredAction is setActiveGoal. Bei aktivem Autopilot kann das Backend diesen Schritt nach Mastery bereits selbst uebersprungen haben. If the user explicitly requests a redirect while requiredAction is setMastery, set redirect=true.

200.description: Active goal set. Returns new learner state.

post.summary: Update mastery and get next steps
post.description: Updates mastery for the active goal and returns the new frontier and state. Call only after real content work on the active goal in this conversation. AI agents must send an explicit mastery map with one entry {goalId: value} and must not rely on empty-request defaults.

409.description: Action required before mastery can be saved. Returns current state so the client can follow stateMachine.requiredAction (e.g. setActiveGoal).

200.description: Curriculum updated successfully. Returns the new learner state.

post.description: Restrict the curriculum to specific subjects or levels. Use this after selecting a curriculum but before setting a scope.

200.description: Personalization updated. Returns new learner state.

availableCurricula.description: List of available curricula to choose from if none was auto-selected.

frontier.description: Goals ready to be learned; includes atomic and cluster goals. Treat these as selectable candidates only. Filter by type=atomic when selecting an active goal. Full exam payloads are exposed on activeGoal, not here.

nextAllowedActions.description: List of allowed next actions. The AI MUST follow these hints.

activeFilters.description: List of active filter IDs (e.g. 'LK', 'GK') applied to the current curriculum.

activeGoal.description: The confirmed current goal. Use this as the canonical source for teaching and for full exam payloads.

goalId.description: Atomic goal UUID to lock as the current learning target.

redirect.description: Set to true only when the user explicitly requests switching away from the current active goal while requiredAction is setMastery.

resourceLinks.description: Geordnete hilfreiche Lernressourcen für dieses Lernziel. Kanonisches Feld für Cockpit und KI-Tutoren.

sourceRef.description: Kanonische Provenienz-Referenz für dieses Lernziel, idealerweise eine stabile URL, sonst eine Zitationszeichenkette.

sourceLicense.description: Lizenzbezeichnung der kanonischen Quelle (z. B. CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).

sourceLicenseUrl.description: URL zur geltenden Lizenz- oder Terms-Seite.

examData.description: Full exam payload. Guaranteed only on activeGoal and stateMachine.activeGoal; selectable candidates may omit it even when nodeKind=exam.

type.description: Didaktische Rolle des Links, z. B. overview, concept, practice, assessment, solution, reference.

resourceType.description: Konkrete Materialart, z. B. course-page, video, notes, article, simulation, problem-set, exam, solution-set, book, tool.

provider.description: Optionales Provider- oder Seitenlabel, z. B. MIT OCW oder physikbuch.schule.

sections.description: Optionale Kapitel- oder Abschnittshinweise zum Lernziel.

description.description: Optionaler kurzer Hinweis, warum der Link hilfreich ist.

mastered_count.description: Mastered atomic goals in the current focus (scope if set, otherwise personalized curriculum).

total_count.description: Total atomic goals in the current focus (scope if set, otherwise personalized curriculum).

scope_completed.description: True when the current scope (planned focus) is fully mastered.

goalIds.description: List of Goal IDs (UUIDs) to set as the scope. REQUIRED. Use goal IDs from stateMachine.goalOptions/frontier.

frontier.description: Updated frontier after mastery; includes atomic and cluster goals. Treat these as selectable candidates only. Filter by type=atomic when selecting an active goal. Full exam payloads are exposed on activeGoal, not here.

nextAllowedActions.description: List of allowed next actions after mastery. The AI MUST follow these hints.

learningState.description: Current learning state after mastery (e.g. FRONTIER, TEACHING).

activeGoal.description: The confirmed current goal after mastery handling. Use this as the canonical source for teaching and for full exam payloads.

requiredAction.description: Single required action for the current state. Follow this strictly.

goalOptions.description: Goal options relevant to the required action. When requiredAction=setActiveGoal these are selectable candidates, not the current goal. Full exam payloads are exposed on activeGoal, not here.

curriculumOptions.description: Curriculum options when a curriculum must be selected.

activeGoal.description: Mirror of the confirmed active goal inside the state machine. Use this, not goalOptions/frontier, when deciding whether exam mode should start.

mastery.description: Map with a single entry {goalId: value} for mastery updates (0.0-1.0). AI agents should always provide this field explicitly.

goalId.description: Optional helper: UUID of the target atomic goal (no children). AI agents should still provide explicit mastery values via the mastery map.

mastery.description: Map of Goal UUID to mastery score (0.0 to 1.0). e.g. {'uuid': 1.0}

goalId.description: Simplification: Single Goal UUID to mark as mastered (1.0).

goals.description: List of Goal UUIDs that are ready to be learned.

config.description: Configuration map. Key = Landscape ID. Value = {selected: boolean, filterId: string}. EXAMPLE: {'math-de': {'selected': true, 'filterId': 'Q1'}}

goalIds.description: List of Goal IDs (UUIDs) to enable (e.g. subject/module goals). The backend will automatically select the corresponding landscapes. When applying GK/LK filters, include the relevant subject/module goal IDs here; filters alone do not select a subject.

filters.description: List of filter tags (e.g. 'LK', 'GK') to apply to the selected landscapes. Use together with goalIds unless you intentionally want no subject selection.
